mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods with sustained HOUST increase, or HOUST increase does not correlate with other consumer demand indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment combined with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with weak growth
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and low GDPC1 growth does not lead to negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not correlate with other supply-side indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with other labor market strength indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong consumer demand coupled with a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with tight labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of high RSAFS growth and low UNRATE does not lead to positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with accommodative policy indicators.
